{{Otheruses|Docking Bay 42}}
'''Docking Bay 42''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] in [[Meirm City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]]. It was there that the [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Mal Biron]] landed his [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], the ''[[Eyeshine]]'', in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] in order to host a gathering of his smuggling brethren. Many [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]], including [[Elis Helrot/Legends|Elis Helrot]] and [[Kal'Falnl C'ndros]], were in attendance as Biron tasked them with taking on the [[Sisar Run/Legends|Sisar Run]].
